description: This file defines the OpenIdUserIdentity class, which maps the relationship between users and OpenID providers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes entity annotations for ORM mapping, private properties representing database columns, and getter/setter methods for interacting with these properties.

classes.name: OpenIdUserIdentity
classes.description: Entity representing the association between a User and an OpenIdProvider, including user identity information.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User associated with this OpenIdUserIdentity record.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User associated with this OpenIdUserIdentity record.

methods.name: getOpenIdProvider
methods.description: Returns the OpenIdProvider associated with this identity.

methods.name: setOpenIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the OpenIdProvider for this identity.
